title: The Censored History
logline: An exiled historian hires a pilot to broadcast a suppressed history across the sector, but the ruling junta's censor frigate is hunting them down.

roles.description: Old, entirely driven by principle, carrying heavy stacks of drives.
Stern, loyal to the state, views independent thought as a threat.
A massive ancient satellite orbiting in a dead system.
A heavy military cruiser equipped with massive jamming arrays.
The brutal military dictatorship that controls the sector.

public_situation: The {role:ruling_junta} has declared all materials from the "Old Era" strictly forbidden, citing them as a public hazard.
private_truth: The historian has compiled a definitive record proving the junta was founded on a massive, bloody betrayal, and is preparing to broadcast it from the hidden archive.

beats.public_change: The censor frigate arrives in the dead system and begins systematically scanning every asteroid.

missions.reason: The captain hires the pilot to sweep the dead system for unauthorized transmissions.
missions.private_fact: The pilot discovers the historian desperately trying to bring the ancient satellite's power grid online.

missions.reason: The historian begs the pilot to deliver thorium to jumpstart the archive's massive broadcast array.
missions.private_fact: The archive requires so much power it will instantly reveal its location to the frigate.

beats.public_change: The junta begins heavily monitoring all traffic near the dead system.

missions.reason: The captain hires the pilot to buy and deliver heavy comm-jammers to the archive to keep it offline permanently.
missions.private_fact: The jammers are actually powerful explosives disguised as transmitters.

beats.public_change: The historian manages to broadcast a tiny fragment of the truth before being jammed.

missions.reason: The historian asks the pilot to meet a bribed guard at the archive's loading dock and physically collect the master drives before the frigate destroys them.
missions.private_fact: The historian is mortally wounded from a localized explosion and cannot carry the drives themselves.

beats.public_change: The censor frigate locks its main weapons on the archive.

missions.reason: The historian begs the pilot to destroy the censor frigate so the full broadcast can be made.
missions.private_fact: The captain hails the pilot, ordering them to hand over the master drives or face execution by the state.

resolutions.summary: The frigate is destroyed, and the full history is broadcast. The sector erupts in rebellion against the junta. The historian dies knowing the truth is safe.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot fought off a military frigate to broadcast a suppressed history to the sector.

resolutions.summary: The pilot hands over the drives. The captain vaporizes the archive and the historian. The truth is lost forever, and the pilot is paid off by the state.
The frigate obliterates the archive. The historian is captured and exiled to a penal colony. The junta's lies remain the official truth.

loose_threads.detail: The junta was actually installed by a foreign power to keep the sector destabilized.
The historian used to be the head of the junta's propaganda department before they found their conscience.

radio_hooks: Unauthorized transmissions detected in dead system.
{role:ruling_junta} issues warnings against listening to "enemy propaganda".

voice_direction.exiled_historian: Frail, raspy, but speaks with burning conviction.
voice_direction.loyalist_captain: Brisk, authoritative, views history as a weapon.
